_comment: Recommended runtime settings of the CsCode app, chosen by the GC matrix in docs/MEMORY.md (section 3; measured on Linux x64). build/MemoryDefaults.props encodes the same as MSBuild properties for CsCode.App.csproj. GCSettings.LatencyMode = SustainedLowLatency is set in code (AppStartup.ConfigureRuntime), not here.
